TITLE 4 THEME 1 CHILD


23:43pm 26-10-29 Thur


THE SECRET CODE OF THE OLD LAW
30 Days of Discovering Jesus in Leviticus
Christine A.
Illustrated by [Illustrator Name]


Copyright © 2026 Christine A.. All rights reserved. This printable is for personal family use only. Not for resale. No part of this book may be reproduced in any form without permission from the author.


A Note for Parents


Have you ever tried to read the book of Leviticus? It is a book in the Bible. It is full of rules. Rules about animals. Rules about food. Rules about clothes. Rules about skin. Rules about houses. It can be confusing. It can be boring. It can make you want to close the book.


But here is the secret. Leviticus is not just a book of rules. It is a book of clues. It is a secret code. Every rule is a clue. Every rule is a picture. Every rule is a shadow. They are all pointing to something. They are all pointing to someone. That someone is Jesus.


This book is a 30 day adventure for you and your kids. We are going to look at some of the rules in Leviticus. We are going to crack the secret code. We are going to find the surprise. The surprise is always Jesus. Get ready to be detectives. Get ready to look for clues. Get ready to find Jesus in the book of Leviticus.


How to Use This Book


This is a 30 day journey. Each day takes about 5 to 10 minutes. Read the secret code. Read the big reveal. Do the family activity together. Say the prayer out loud. Let your child color the picture. The goal is not perfection. The goal is connection. Have fun with it. Get messy. Ask questions. Laugh together. This is an adventure. Let us begin.


---

pages.body:
The Secret Code
"If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you are to offer a male without defect. You must present it at the entrance to the tent of meeting so that it may be acceptable to the LORD." - Leviticus 1:3


The burnt offering was a special sacrifice. The animal had to be perfect. It had to have no defects. It had to be offered at the entrance to the tent. It had to be burned completely. The smoke went up to heaven. It was a sweet smell to God. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"Christ loved us and gave himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God." - Ephesians 5:2


The burnt offering was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus was the perfect offering. He had no defects. He had no sin. He was offered at the cross. He was burned. He was consumed. He was a sweet smell to God. The code is cracked. Jesus is the burnt offering.


Family Activity
Light a candle. Watch the flame. Talk about how the burnt offering was completely consumed. Talk about how Jesus gave everything for us. He was consumed. He was the perfect offering. We are thankful for His sacrifice.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the perfect offering. Thank you for giving everything for me. Thank you for being a sweet smell to God. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A perfect lamb with a big heart on it.

pages.body:
The Secret Code
"If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed." - Leviticus 4:3


The sin offering was a special sacrifice. It was for sin. It was for guilt. It was for the priest. It was for the people. The blood was sprinkled. The fat was burned. The rest was burned outside the camp. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God." - 2 Corinthians 5:21


The sin offering was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus was made sin for us. He took our sin. He took our guilt. He took our shame. He was burned outside the camp. He was the sin offering. The code is cracked. Jesus is the sin offering.


Family Activity
Write a mistake on a piece of paper. Talk about how the sin offering took away sin. Talk about how Jesus took away our sin. Crumple the paper and throw it away. Our sin is gone. Jesus took it.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the sin offering. Thank you for taking my sin. Thank you for taking my guilt. Thank you for taking my shame. I love you. Amen."

The guilt offering was a special sacrifice. It was for guilt. It was for the things you wish you could undo. It was for the things you cannot forget. The person had to confess. They had to bring a sacrifice. The priest made atonement. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"Yet it was the LORD's will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the LORD makes his life an offering for guilt, he will see his offspring and prolong his days." - Isaiah 53:10


The guilt offering was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus was crushed. He suffered. He was the offering for guilt. He paid for the things you wish you could undo. He paid for the things you cannot forget. The code is cracked. Jesus is the guilt offering.


Family Activity
Talk about a time you felt guilty. Talk about how Jesus took that guilt. Talk about how He paid for it. We can let it go. We can be free. Jesus took our guilt.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the guilt offering. Thank you for paying for my guilt. Thank you for taking it away. Help me to let it go. I love you. Amen."

The Secret Code

The trespass offering was a special sacrifice. It was for trespasses. It was for cheating. It was for stealing. It was for lying. The person had to confess. They had to pay back. They had to add a fifth. They had to bring a sacrifice. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God." - 1 Peter 3:18


The trespass offering was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus suffered for our trespasses. He suffered for our cheating. He suffered for our stealing. He suffered for our lying. He paid it back. He added the fifth. He brought us to God. The code is cracked. Jesus is the trespass offering.

Kid's Prayer

"For our God is a consuming fire." - Hebrews 12:29


The fire was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the consuming fire. He is the one who burns away our sin. He is the one who purifies us. He is the one who keeps the fire burning in our hearts. The code is cracked. Jesus is the fire.


Family Activity

Kid's Prayer

"For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ." - Galatians 3:27


The priest's clothes were a clue. They pointed to Jesus. Jesus clothes us with Himself. He covers us. He makes us holy. He makes us priests. We can serve God. We can remove the ashes. We can do His work. The code is cracked. Jesus is the priest's clothes.

The Secret Code
"For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life." - Leviticus 17:11


The blood was special. It was holy. It was the life of the creature. It was given for atonement. It was given for forgiveness. It was given for cleansing. The blood was on the altar. The blood was sprinkled. The blood was poured out. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?

The scapegoat was a special goat. The high priest laid his hands on it. He confessed the sins of the people. He put the sins on the goat's head. He sent the goat away. The goat carried the sins into the wilderness. The goat took the sins away. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all." - Isaiah 53:6


The scapegoat was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the scapegoat. The sins of the world were laid on Him. He carried them away. He took them to the cross. He took them to the grave. He removed them from us. The code is cracked. Jesus is the scapegoat.


Family Activity
Write a mistake on a piece of paper. Tie it to a balloon. Let the balloon go. Talk about how the scapegoat carried the sins away. Talk about how Jesus carries our sins away. They are gone.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for carrying my sins away. Thank you for taking them to the cross. Thank you for removing them. I love you. Amen."

The Day of Atonement was the holiest day of the year. It was a day of fasting. It was a day of sacrifice. It was a day of cleansing. The high priest entered the Most Holy Place. He offered sacrifices. The blood was sprinkled. The people were cleansed. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption." - Hebrews 9:12


The Day of Atonement was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the Day of Atonement. He is the high priest. He is the sacrifice. He entered the Most Holy Place once for all. He obtained eternal redemption. The code is cracked. Jesus is the Day of Atonement.

The Secret Code
"The LORD said to Moses: 'Tell your brother Aaron that he is not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die.'" - Leviticus 16:2


The high priest was special. He was the only one who could enter the Most Holy Place. He could not go in whenever he wanted. He had to follow the rules. He had to bring blood. He had to be clean. If he did it wrong, he would die. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess." - Hebrews 4:14


The high priest was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is our High Priest. He entered the Most Holy Place. He entered it once for all. He entered it with His own blood. He did not die. He rose again. The code is cracked. Jesus is the High Priest.


Family Activity
Talk about how the high priest had to be careful. Talk about how Jesus is our High Priest. He entered the Most Holy Place for us. He made a way. We can come to God because of Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being my High Priest. Thank you for entering the Most Holy Place. Thank you for making a way. I love you. Amen."

pages.body:
The Secret Code
"Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the covenant law behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place." - Exodus 26:33


The veil was a thick curtain. It separated the people from the Most Holy Place. It separated them from the presence of God. The people could not go in. Only the high priest could go in. Once a year. The veil was a barrier. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom." - Matthew 27:51


The veil was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. The veil separated the people from God. When Jesus died, the veil was torn in two. The barrier was removed. The separation was ended. The code is cracked. Jesus is the veil. He is the one who tore the curtain.


Family Activity
Take a piece of paper. Talk about how it separates you from something. Then rip the paper in half. Talk about how the veil was torn when Jesus died. We can come to God now. We have access.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for removing the barrier. Thank you for tearing the veil. Thank you for giving me access to God. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt

Make a small box. Decorate it with gold paper. Put something special inside. Talk about how the ark held the things of God. Talk about how Jesus is the meeting place. We meet God in Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the meeting place. Thank you for bringing me to God. Thank you for making a way. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A golden box with a big heart on it.
pages.title: Day 21: The Code of the Ark

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"Make an atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide." - Exodus 25:17


The mercy seat was the lid of the ark. It was made of pure gold. It was the place where the blood was sprinkled. It was the place of atonement. It was the place of mercy. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"God presented Christ as a sacrifice of atonement, through the shedding of his blood—to be received by faith." - Romans 3:25


The mercy seat was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the mercy seat. He is the atonement. He is the place of mercy. His blood was sprinkled. His sacrifice was made. The code is cracked. Jesus is the mercy seat.


Family Activity
Draw a golden box with a lid. Talk about how the mercy seat was the lid of the ark. Talk about how Jesus is the mercy seat. He is the place of mercy. We can come to Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the mercy seat. Thank you for being the atonement. Thank you for being the place of mercy. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A golden box with a big smile on the lid.
pages.title: Day 22: The Code of the Mercy Seat

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover." - Exodus 25:18


The two cherubim were angels. They were made of gold. They were placed on the mercy seat. They faced each other. Their wings spread out. They represented the presence of God. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"And he made known to us the mystery of his will according to his good pleasure, which he purposed in Christ, to be put into effect when the times reach their fulfillment—to bring unity to all things in heaven and on earth under Christ." - Ephesians 1:9-10


The two cherubim were a clue. They pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the one who brings unity. He is the one who brings heaven and earth together. He is the presence of God. The code is cracked. Jesus is the two cherubim.


Family Activity
Draw two angels facing each other. Talk about how the cherubim were on the mercy seat. Talk about how Jesus brings unity. He brings heaven and earth together. He brings us together.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for bringing unity. Thank you for bringing heaven and earth together. Thank you for bringing us together. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
Two angels with a big heart between them.
pages.title: Day 23: The Code of the Two Cherubim

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"Put the altar in front of the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law—before the atonement cover that is over the tablets of the covenant law—where I will meet with you." - Exodus 30:6


The golden altar was the altar of incense. It was in the Holy Place. It was before the curtain. It was where the priest burned incense. It was where the prayers rose to God. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess." - Hebrews 4:14


The golden altar was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is our High Priest. He is the one who prays for us. He is the one who intercedes for us. The code is cracked. Jesus is the golden altar.


Family Activity
Talk about how the golden altar was where the prayers rose to God. Talk about how Jesus is our High Priest. He prays for us. He intercedes for us. We can pray to God because of Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being my High Priest. Thank you for praying for me. Thank you for interceding for me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A golden altar with a big heart.
pages.title: Day 24: The Code of the Golden Altar

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide." - Exodus 27:1


The bronze altar was the altar of burnt offering. It was outside the tabernacle. It was the place of sacrifice. It was the place of fire. It was the place where the blood was shed. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat." - Hebrews 13:10


The bronze altar was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the altar. He is the sacrifice. He is the place where sin is dealt with. He is the place where blood is shed. The code is cracked. Jesus is the bronze altar.


Family Activity
Build an altar out of blocks. Put a toy animal on it. Talk about how the bronze altar was the place of sacrifice. Talk about how Jesus is the altar. He took the fire for us. He is the sacrifice.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the altar. Thank you for taking the fire for me. Thank you for being the sacrifice. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
An altar with a big heart on it.
pages.title: Day 25: The Code of the Bronze Altar

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"For six days work is to be done, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, holy to the LORD." - Exodus 31:15


The Sabbath was a day of rest. It was a day of ceasing. The people were told to stop working. They were told to rest. They were told to trust. It was a day of rest. It was a day of worship. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28


The Sabbath was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is our rest. He is the one who gives us peace. He is the one who gives us rest. The code is cracked. Jesus is the Sabbath.


Family Activity
Have a day of rest. Take a nap. Read a book. Go for a walk. Talk about how God wants us to rest. Talk about how Jesus is our rest. We can rest in Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being my rest. Thank you for giving me peace. Thank you for giving me rest. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A person sleeping peacefully with a big smile.
pages.title: Day 26: The Code of the Sabbath

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each of you is to return to your family property and to your own clan." - Leviticus 25:10


The Year of Jubilee was a year of freedom. It was a year of release. It was a year of restoration. Every fifty years, the Israelites were to proclaim liberty. Slaves were set free. Debts were cancelled. Land was returned. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free, to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor." - Luke 4:18-19


The Jubilee was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the Jubilee. He is the freedom. He is the release. He is the restoration. He proclaims good news to the poor. He proclaims freedom to the prisoners. The code is cracked. Jesus is the Jubilee.


Family Activity
Ring a bell. Shout "Freedom!" Talk about how the Jubilee was a year of freedom. Talk about how Jesus sets us free. We can be free because of Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being my Jubilee. Thank you for proclaiming freedom to me. Thank you for releasing me from bondage. Thank you for restoring me. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A bell with a big smile.
pages.title: Day 27: The Code of the Jubilee

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God." - Exodus 23:19


The firstfruits was an offering. It was the first sheaf of the harvest. The Israelites were told to bring it to God. It was a sign of trust. It showed they believed God would provide the rest. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep." - 1 Corinthians 15:20


The firstfruits was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the firstfruits. He is the first to rise from the dead. His resurrection is a promise that we too will rise. The code is cracked. Jesus is the firstfruits.


Family Activity
Pick a piece of fruit. Talk about how the firstfruits was the first of the harvest. Talk about how Jesus is the firstfruits. He rose from the dead. We will rise too.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for rising from the dead. Thank you for being the firstfruits. Thank you for the promise that we will rise too. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A piece of fruit with a big smile.
pages.title: Day 28: The Code of the Firstfruits

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD." - Leviticus 27:30


The tithe was ten percent. The Israelites were told to give ten percent of their crops and their livestock to God. It was a sign of trust. It was a sign of gratitude. This is a secret code. It is a clue. What does it mean?


The Big Reveal
"Honor the LORD with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops; then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine." - Proverbs 3:9-10


The tithe was a clue. It pointed to Jesus. Jesus gave everything. He gave one hundred percent. And because He gave everything, we can give generously. We can trust God with our money. The code is cracked. Jesus is the tithe.


Family Activity
Count out ten coins. Set aside one for God. Talk about how the tithe was ten percent. Talk about how Jesus gave everything. We can give generously because of Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for giving everything for me. Help me to trust you with my money. Help me to be generous. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A coin with a big heart on it.
pages.title: Day 29: The Code of the Tithe

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Secret Code
"These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ." - Colossians 2:17


All the rules in Leviticus were shadows. They were clues. They were pointing to something. They were pointing to someone. They were pointing to Jesus.


The Big Reveal
"For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed." - 1 Corinthians 5:7


Jesus is the real code. He is the fulfillment of every rule. He is the meaning behind every ceremony. He is the treasure at the end of the hunt. The code is cracked. Jesus is the one we were looking for all along.


Family Activity
Have a code-breaking party. Make a simple cipher. Write a message that says "Jesus loves you." Let your child decode it. Talk about how we cracked the code of Leviticus. The code is Jesus. We found Him. We love Him. We thank Him.


Kid's Prayer
"Thank you, Jesus, for being the real code. Thank you for being the fulfillment of every rule. Thank you for being the treasure. Help me to live in the reality. Help me to live in you. I love you. Amen."


Coloring Prompt
A big treasure chest with a cross and a big smile.

A Note for the Parent: Building on the Foundation


You did it. You spent 30 days cracking the secret code of Leviticus. But the adventure does not end here. It is just beginning.


Here are a few tips to keep going:


1. Make it a habit, not a chore. Do not stress about reading the Bible for 30 minutes a day. A simple 5 minute rhythm before bed is better than an hour once a month.
2. Let them see you reading. Kids do what they see. Let them catch you reading your Bible. Let them see that it matters to you.
3. Ask "Where is Jesus?" in every story. Whenever you read a Bible story, ask your child, "Where do you see Jesus in this story?" This trains them to look for Jesus everywhere.
4. Recommended next steps. Read The Jesus Storybook Bible by Sally Lloyd-Jones. Read The Biggest Story by Kevin DeYoung. Keep pointing them to the Treasure.


You are doing a great job. Keep going.
